name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Houthi attack wounds 11 in Riyadh on 24 Nov; coalition strikes Hodeidah 25 Nov; Houthis claim Jeddah and Jazan attacks
state: A Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District wounded 11 people on 24 Nov; on 25 Nov the Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port and targets in Saada and Amran and said it downed four drones over Ras Tanura (The National). Later on 25 Nov the Houthis claimed attacks on Jeddah and Jazan ports, and the coalition said a projectile hit Jazan with minor damage and no casualties (Middle East Eye). Cross-border strikes on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and the wider region, which is changing at short notice.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation and major cross-border strikes = Alert
